partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Causal-target indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A known non-blind indication can support a new indication when the drug inhibits the same tissue-localized causal gene for both diseases.
results.body: drug treats training anchor disease and binds/decreases gene; same gene causes anchor and candidate disease; candidate satisfies R037 tissue and adverse constraints
results.mechanism_rationale: Transfers efficacy through an explicit shared inhibited causal target and candidate-disease tissue context rather than generic disease similarity, but it depends on an existing treatment edge and still lacks disease activity direction.
results.trapi_notes: The shared-target and treatment-anchor motifs are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, derived anatomy context, exact absence, NPMI, and degree constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[:CAUSES]->(anchor)
WHERE anchor <> object
  AND any(
    source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE NOT source IN [$validation_source, $blind_source]
  )
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_min_anatomy_disease_degree <= 200
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4
      )
    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Anatomy-corroborated causal-target transfer
results.hypothesis: Causal-target indication transfer should become more specific when the known anchor and candidate diseases also share a relatively specific anatomy.
results.body: R046 plus anchor and candidate disease share located_in|occurs_in anatomy with disease degree <=200
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines a known indication, shared inhibited causal target, target expression context, and shared disease anatomy; treatment dependence and disease activity direction remain limitations.
results.trapi_notes: The branched graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, anatomy specificity, exact absence, NPMI, and degree constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[:CAUSES]->(anchor)
MATCH (anchor)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(shared_anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]-(object)
WHERE anchor <> object
  AND any(
    source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE NOT source IN [$validation_source, $blind_source]
  )
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_min_anatomy_disease_degree <= 200
  AND shared_anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 200
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4
      )
    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
